description: This file defines a serializer class `ByteStringCodec` for the `ByteString` type using the Orleans serialization framework with Protobuf support. It implements methods for reading from and writing to serialization streams, handling reference tracking and wire protocol specifics.

classes.name: ByteStringCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for `ByteString` implementing the `IFieldCodec<ByteString>` interface, capable of reading and writing `ByteString` objects in the Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a `ByteString` value from the serialization stream, handling reference types and length-prefixed data.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a `ByteString` value to the serialization stream, including proper wire formatting and reference management.
